plain: Earn 2% of your money back on everything you buy, 3% back on groceries, and 5% back on trips you book through our website, up to $1,500 every three months.
alt: Every purchase pays you back 2%, groceries pay back 3%, and travel booked on our portal pays back 5%, with up to $1,500 in rewards each quarter.
frame_flip: Don't miss out on 2% cash back on every purchase, 3% on groceries, and 5% on travel booked through our portal, up to $1,500 per quarter you'd otherwise leave on the table.
